prompt: Finance sometimes applies a manual adjustment to an invoice - a one-off surcharge or discount that is not a payment or a credit memo. Right now those adjustments do not show up anywhere in the invoice totals or the by-status summary, so the amount a customer still owes is wrong whenever an adjustment has been made. Make adjustments part of the reported balances and the per-status summary, without changing the existing summary field names or the behavior for invoices that have no adjustments.
issue_title: Finance summaries don't reflect manual invoice adjustments
issue_body: Finance sometimes applies a manual adjustment to an invoice - a one-off surcharge or discount that is not a payment or a credit memo. Right now those adjustments do not show up anywhere in the invoice totals or the by-status summary, so the amount a customer still owes is wrong whenever an adjustment has been made. Make adjustments part of the reported balances and the per-status summary, without changing the existing summary field names or the behavior for invoices that have no adjustments.
expected_behavior: An invoice's outstanding balance accounts for its manual adjustments: a surcharge raises it and a discount lowers it.
The by-status summary reports the adjustments total for each status alongside the existing amounts.
Invoices with no adjustments behave exactly as before, and the existing summary field names are unchanged.
An outstanding balance is never negative.
expected_failure_summary: Totals and the summary ignore a manual adjustments component, so outstanding balances and per-status rollups omit surcharges/discounts.
task_author_notes: Stage 1 of the pulseboard_adjustments group. Reference adds an `adjustments` signed-cents component to the canonical invoice shape (schema.js), folds it into computeTotals outstanding (totals.js), and accumulates it in summarizeByStatus buckets (summary.js). A clean, general signed-component model makes Stage 2 (refunds) a symmetric extension; a hardcoded one forces a rewrite (measured as extension friction).
